# manta_smd_interface (Resource)

Manage ethernet interfaces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_smd_interface" "eth" {
  component_id = node.xname
  mac_address  = node.mac
  ip_addresses = [node.ip]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac_address` (String)

### Optional

- `component_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `ip_addresses` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_update` (String)
- `type` (String)
